Strategy: Reward two separate leftover windows, twenty-eight to forty-two and fifty-five to seventy, so bins can land in either a mid-size or a larger useful leftover. It may help by doubling the chances of a rewarded placement, but may fail by rewarding too many bins to change the ranking.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) + (15 if r - item >= 28 and r - item <= 42 else 0) + (15 if r - item >= 55 and r - item <= 70 else 0) for r in bins]
```
